column6: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.
A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
The target is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the target has left.
The user raises its allies' critical hit ratio with a draconic cry. This rouses Dragon types more.
Attacks using an angelic voice. This confuses the target if its stats have been raised this turn.
Attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. Prevents the target from healing for two turns.
An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. Fails if the target isn't using a high priority move.
